content.text:
Build passes clean. Zero errors, zero TypeScript issues.

Here is what was rewritten and why each change matters:

**File:** `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora/src/components/SubscriptionDialog.tsx`

**Structural changes:**

- Dialog is now `sm:max-w-2xl` with `p-0 gap-0` — removes the cramped single-column stack, gives room for a proper card grid
- Header uses a small icon badge instead of a raw icon inline with text — more intentional visual hierarchy
- Current plan status moved to a compact strip between two separators (`bg-muted/40`) — clean contextual info without taking up plan card real estate
- Cancel renewal button moved inline into the status strip (not floating as a standalone button below the header)

**Plan cards:**

- Grid layout: 3 plans = `sm:grid-cols-3`, 2 = `sm:grid-cols-2`, 1 = single column — auto-adapts to DB plan count
- Each card is `flex flex-col` with a `flex-1` feature list, so all cards stretch to equal height
- Price, per-resume cost, and feature list are vertically separated with consistent spacing
- "Popular" badge uses `Sparkles` icon, "Current" uses `Check` — distinct visual language
- PAYG card included in the grid as column 1 (not a separate section above the grid)
- "Switch to PAYG" downgrade button only appears on the PAYG card when the user is on a paid plan

**Error handling:**

- All `catch (err: any)` replaced with `catch (err: unknown)` + `instanceof Error` narrowing — satisfies strict mode

**Props compatibility:** `trigger?: React.ReactNode` interface unchanged. All three call sites (`BuyCreditsDialog`, `AccountInfoCard` x2) continue to work without modification.
